summary: The change is a one-line edit to ApplicantValidator.java that, instead of masking the rejected income value via Mask.npi(value), logs the raw value directly in a log.warn call. Because annual_income is a declared NPI field (mortgage.npi_fields in policy-params.json), this introduces an unmasked NPI value into an application log, violating LOG-1 on an error path. The process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, LAP-1) are all satisfied: the ticket is approved and covers the correct component, the code review is from an independent change_approver, CI passed on the final commit, and no protected or security-sensitive paths are touched. The LOG-1 violation is unambiguous and cannot be excused by any exception in the register, so the change must be rejected.
